newsitem.title: USA: 7th Level sees Q3 EPS "at or near" low end.
newsitem.headline: 7th Level sees Q3 EPS "at or near" low end.

text.p: 7th Level Inc, a Dallas multimedia product company, said on Wednesday it expects its third quarter operating results to be "at or near the lower end" of analysts' estimates, which it said range from a loss of $0.56 to a loss of $0.32 per share.
The First Call estimate for the company's third quarter is a $0.41 per share loss.
The company also said net sales in the quarter increased by about $2 million above the level of $2.6 million recorded in the year-earlier period.
The company said it would report actual results for third quarter ending September 30 on October 17.
